items: Router Configuration: The router web interface is used to manage router settings. It is opened using a web browser. The user enters the router’s IP address to access it. A username and password are required to log in. The interface allows changes in Wi-Fi name and password. It also helps control security settings.

Wi-Fi Encryption: Protects data sent over the network. It converts data into a secure form. WPA2 and WPA3 are common security protocols. Older protocols like WEP are not secure. Strong encryption prevents data theft. Users should always select the latest encryption method.

Default Gateway: A default gateway connects a local network to other networks. It is usually a router. Data meant for outside networks goes through the gateway. The gateway forwards data to the correct network. Internet access depends on it. Proper gateway setting is necessary.
